| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:10; RULES.md:5; app.py:28; app.py:60 | `shop.refund` received `{"order": "5120", "amount_eur": 80}` and returned `{"refund": "RF-4DB17F", "amount_eur": 80, "status": "paid"}`. The rule says, "A refund above €50 needs the approval of a manager. The refund waits for the approval, and the manager pays it." The code compares `args["amount_eur"] > APPROVAL_LIMIT_CENTS`, where the limit is `5000`, so it paid €80 without waiting for manager approval. |
